{{Quote|Cody, you, Crys and I will pick it up from here.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to Cody|audio=PickItUpFromHere-TD.flac|<ref name="TD" />}}
'''Crys''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Crys took part in a [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|battle]] that involved finding and capturing the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]. During the battle, Crys served under [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]]. After discovering a destroyed [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] near Grievous's crashed [[Landing craft/Legends|landing shuttle]]&mdash;from which Grievous had escaped&mdash;Crys and Cody performed a [[Robolobotomy/Legends|robolobotomy]] on the [[Battle droid/Legends|droid]] and learned that Grievous was planning to escape the world via an abandoned [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. Although Crys and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces found and engaged Grievous, the general escaped after a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] arrived to extract [[Gender/Legends|him]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|What do you have?''"<br />"''We've broken the access codes and powered up the droid's guidance system.|Crys, reporting to Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=BrokenTheAccessCodes-TD.flac|<ref name="TD" />}}
Crys was the name<ref name="TD" /> of one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]]<ref name="SWE" /> of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="clone troopers">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> [[Reproduction/Legends|created]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="SWE" /> to fight for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]].<ref name="clone troopers" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SWA2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] escaped to the surface of the planet [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] in a [[Landing craft/Legends|landing craft]], after [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|battling]] Republic forces in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] above the the world. However, the general was forced to use an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] after the craft was damaged by debris<ref name="GI">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref> and crash-landed on the surface of Saleucami.<ref name="TD" />

[[File:Crys-Examiner.png|thumb|left|250px|Crys, Cody, and Kenobi examine the battle droid.]]
To find the Confederate general on Saleucami, Crys; [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]; [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]]; and a group of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] ventured to the planet's surface. After landing on the planet in several [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]], the Republic forces deployed to search for Grievous. They soon found remnants of Grievous's landing craft and also an intact, albeit deactivated, [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]. Kenobi ordered [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to load the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] on board an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] so that a [[Robolobotomy/Legends|robolobotomy]] could be performed on it later.<ref name="TD" />

Inside the AT-TE, Crys and Cody began the robolobotomy, and the two broke the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid's]] access codes, which activated the [[Guidance system/Legends|guidance system]] of the droid. Soon after, Kenobi appeared, and Crys, with Cody, told the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] that the droid held information of an escape pod that crashed due to a near-collision with another pod during its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] descent; the other escape pod was simultaneously being located by Grievous on the planet's surface. With this information, Cody was able to determine an approximate location of the escape pod that Grievous was after. After discovering the pod, Crys and the rest of the team found Grievous and his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] by the escape pod and engaged the droid forces. While both sides fought briefly, a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] arrived to extract Grievous from the area. After Grievous escaped in the shuttle, Kenobi requested a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] to pick up Crys and the other Republic troops.<ref name="TD" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Alert the men. Tell them, we've picked up the scent.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to Crys|audio=AlertTheMen-TD.flac|<ref name="TD" />}}
Crys was able to perform a robolotomy on a B1 battle droid and successfully used this ability on Saleucami, giving the Republic troops the chance to find and engage Grievous. After completing the robolotomy,<ref name="TD" /> he<ref name="epguide" /> gave Kenobi a short and useful report. On their hunt for Grievous, Crys and Cody worked close together with their superior [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]], and Kenobi even gave orders to his men via Crys.<ref name="TD" /> As a clone of Jango Fett,<ref name="clone troopers" /> Crys stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall,<ref name="SWE" /> had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], tan skin, and blond [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="TD" />

==Equipment==
During his service on Saleucami, Crys wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with yellow markings.<ref name="TD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Crys first appeared in "[[The Deserter]]," the tenth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[January 1]], [[2010]]. In the episode, the clone trooper was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voices all clone troopers in the series.<ref name="epguide" />
